title: Act: Carry animations and origin into generated entries and register boy sources
summary: Extend ArtSource and generateAssets, add boy animations, register in ART_SOURCES
description: Add optional animations and origin to ArtSource, copy them in generateAssets, declare boy animations and origin, register BOY_SOURCES.
acceptance_criteria: Entries copy animations and origin when present

preserve: entries for sources without the fields

steps.action: Add optional fields animations?: Record<string, AnimationDef> and origin?: Origin, importing types AnimationDef and Origin from '@game/assets/manifest'.
steps.expected: ArtSource accepts the new optional fields

steps.action: Import BOY_SOURCES from './boy' and change the array to [hand cursor entry, ...BOY_SOURCES].
steps.expected: ART_SOURCES lists cursor-hand then the boy sheet and portrait

steps.action: In both entries.push calls, spread optional fields: ...(source.animations ? { animations: source.animations } : {}), ...(source.origin ? { origin: source.origin } : {}).
steps.expected: Entries include animations and origin only when the source has them

steps.action: Add animations idle {frames:[0,1,2,3],frameRate:6,repeat:-1}, walk {frames:[4,5,6,7,8,9],frameRate:10,repeat:-1}, interact {frames:[10,11,12,13],frameRate:8,repeat:0} and origin {x:0.5,y:1}.
steps.expected: Sheet source declares three animations and origin
